One function with its only prologue at 0x080f4168 and its epilogue tail at 0x080f535e, spanning 0x080f4168..0x080f53cd. Three of its 108 bl sites are internal control edges (0x080f535e twice, 0x080f44b8 once) and two are _call_via_r3 thunk calls. The whole-row literal pools at 0x080f474a (114 bytes), 0x080f4ab2 (62) and 0x080f4eca (58) are excluded: every word in them is the destination of a pc-relative ldr from a neighbouring row and nothing branches into them. One function with its only prologue at 0x080e47b8 and its sole epilogue at 0x080e660a, spanning 16 manifest rows. Of its 231 bl sites, 14 are long branches the build emitted as bl because a Thumb b displacement cannot span 7 KiB, and 53 are interworking veneers through the 0x080072e4 call_via bank. Excluded (380 bytes): the literal pools at 0x080e4ddc (48), 0x080e5790 (36), 0x080e5acc (48), 0x080e5dee (58) and 0x080e6252 (54), plus the 34-entry jump table at 0x080e53f4 (136). A further 776 bytes of pool and alignment sit inside the listed ranges, so pure instruction bytes are 6,606.

One function with its only prologue at 0x080d765c (332-byte frame, never restored until the end) and its sole epilogue at 0x080d829a, reached through plain b edges across nine manifest rows. Ten of its 91 bl sites are call_via thunk-bank indirect calls whose via-register is loaded from frame slots filled once from *(0x03001f08) and *(0x03001f0c); the rest are ordinary calls and no internal edge is emitted as bl. Excluded pools (290 bytes): 0x080d76d0 (32), 0x080d778c (40), 0x080d7862 (26, interior), 0x080d7bd2 (54), 0x080d7e5c (68, a whole row), 0x080d821a (62) and 0x080d82a8 (8); all 78 pc-relative ldr sites resolve into exactly these pools and no branch targets any of them. Previously recorded as a multi_region_function blocker; resolved by whole-module admission.

One function with its only prologue at 0x080e15e8 and its sole epilogue in the 0x080e21e8 range; every inter-row edge is a plain Thumb b.n and none of the 130 bl sites encodes internal control flow. Eighteen bl sites are call_via thunk-bank indirect calls through live registers (renderer entries from 0x03001f08/0x03001f0c, or relocated IWRAM helpers at 0x0300013c, 0x03001388, 0x03000168). Two further calls use the inline mov ip,pc; bx r7 idiom into the relocated ARM helper at 0x03000118 and return inline into the same range. Excluded as data (316 bytes): interior pools 0x080e1660 (28), 0x080e1704 (32), 0x080e179c (40), 0x080e1830 (24 plus 2 alignment) and 0x080e1a98 (52), plus the whole rows 0x080e1daa (78) and 0x080e21ae (58), each confirmed by resolving sibling pc-relative ldr targets. Previously recorded as a multi_region_function blocker; resolved by whole-module admission. The 592-byte span from 0x080e1848 is listed as two ranges because it crosses the manifest row boundary at 0x080e1a48; the code is contiguous.

One function across four manifest rows. The two mov ip,pc; bx r4 sequences at 0x0800f1ba and 0x0800f1c6 are ordinary indirect calls to the IWRAM-relocated ARM multiply at 0x03000118: mov ip,pc sets the return to the instruction after bx, and both landing sites continue the same live frame. The 62-byte executable-gap row at 0x0800f1bc is the continuation of one statement, not a control-flow anomaly. LAWS.md already records this idiom as a codegen-only difference from bl __call_via_r4. Excluded pools and alignment (90 bytes): 0x0800edf0 (36), 0x0800f186 (30), 0x0800f2ae (18), 0x0800f2d4 (4) and 2 bytes of trailing alignment. Previously recorded as a relocated_kernel_continuation blocker; resolved.
